name: cobblers

rejected_artifacts.reason: sawtooth wraparound across the surface; 7.3% of horizontally adjacent pixels differ by >100; stored as 8-bit RGB with height only in the red channel
landmass clipped to 255 (mean 244, median 255); no land elevation data

notes: origin_x/origin_z are null until the northwest corner is confirmed from in-game F3. The validator fails while they are unset.
bounds are derived from grid origin + cell_size * columns/rows and are not authored by hand.

import.low_in/high_in are fractions of full scale, so they survive the 16-bit re-export unchanged. Tooling multiplies by (2**bit_depth - 1) at read time. They were originally authored as 40 and 254 against an 8-bit file, which is where 0.156863 and 0.996078 come from.
import.low_out/high_out/water_level are absolute Minecraft Y values and never scale.
source_root is machine-specific and is not committed. Set COBBLERS_SOURCE_ROOT or pass --source-root. Expected layout is in data/notes/source_tree.md.
